definitions.gloss: to draw near, to bring close

notes:
{寄|よ}せる is an ichidan verb meaning to bring close, gather, or direct toward something.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {寄|よ}る (intransitive: to approach, to stop by)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {椅子|いす}を{寄|よ}せる: to draw up a chair
- {思|おも}いを{寄|よ}せる: to have feelings for someone
- {信頼|しんらい}を{寄|よ}せる: to place trust in
- {期待|きたい}を{寄|よ}せる: to place expectations on
- {関心|かんしん}を{寄|よ}せる: to take interest in
- {身|み}を{寄|よ}せる: to take shelter with

COMPOUND VERBS:
- {寄|よ}せ{集|あつ}める: to gather together
